(vimuttiyā … nibbānaṃ ~an ti, nibbānassa pana … kiṃ ~an ti); Ja I 213, 28 (idāni me aññaṃ ~aṃ natthi, attāṇo ’mhi asaraṇo); 352, 18 (ṭhapetvā idāni rājānaṃ natthi me añño koci ~an ti); III 423, 25 (mātā pana me dubbalā aham ev’ assā ~aṃ); 508, 26 (mahāpaṭhavisame sabbalokassa ~e narinde); VI 28, 27´ (nekkhammaṃ ~aṃ katvā pabbajassu); 398, 37 (gilānassa kho pana vejjo ~aṃ chātassa bhojanaṃ pipāsitassa pānīyaṃ); Mil 188, 18 (sadevakassa pi lokassa ~aṃ bhavituṃ araho ti); Vism 427, 12 (dukkhassa gati ~an ti duggati); Sp 1353, 23 (migānaṃ … araññaṃ gati ~aṃ hoti); Sv 544, 11 (sambodhi paraṃ ayanaṃ assa gati ~aṃ avassaṃ pattabbā ti sambodhiparāyano); Ps III 407, 2 (nadīnaṃ ādhārato ~ato ca sāgaro mukhan ti vutto); Dhp-a II 15, 19 (khattiyavaṃso ucchijjissati tassa ~aṃ hothā ti); Ud-a 179, 18 foll. (corā … kiñci gahanaṃ vā ~aṃ vā apassantā … taṃ bhikkhuṃ … disvā … amhākaṃ bhante ~aṃ hothā ti yāciṃsu, thero tumhākaṃ sīlasadisapaṭisaraṇaṃ natthi); Pj II 309, 19 (gahaṭṭhassa vā pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipatti yeva ~an ti); Vv-a 231, 29 (ayaṃ me bhagavā saraṇaṃ tāṇaṃ leṇaṃ gati ~an ti); Bv-a 38, 28 (parāyano ti ~aṃ); — ifc see bhagavaṃ- ( sv bhagava[t] ); — appaṭisaraṇa , apaṭisaraṇa ( and appaṭissaraṇa ?), mfn. 1. without a prop or support; without recourse; D III 118, 5 (dhammavinaye duppavedite … bhinnathūpe ~e; Sv 906, 14 : [Nātaputtassa] abhāvena paṭisaraṇavirahite); A II 147, 32 (ye te bhikkhū bahussutā … te na sakkaccaṃ suttantaṃ paraṃ vācenti tesaṃ accayena chinnamūlako suttanto hoti ~o; Mp III 137, 22 : appatiṭṭho); Ja I 466, 7 (daliddo ~o); IV 228, 22 (bhante tumhesu cārikaṃ pakkantesu Jetavanamahāvihāro ~o hoti); Spk III 246, 17 (nibbānaṃ nām’ etaṃ ~aṃ na kiñci paṭisarati); Cp-a 234, 18 (mātāpitunnaṃ apagamanena vā ~o); — 2. without shelter, without protection; Vin II 153, 2 (vihārā anālindakā honti ~ā, Se so; Be, Ce appaṭissaraṇā; Ee apaṭissaraṇā); — nippaṭisarana , mfn. , without recourse; without shelter; Ja I 328, 30 (bhaggavimānā devatā ~ā); — sappaṭisarana , mfn. , having a prop or support; having a recourse; M III 9, 23 (na kho mayaṃ … appaṭisaraṇā, ~ā mayaṃ … dhammapaṭisaraṇā); A II 148, 26 (tesaṃ accayena na ca chinnamūlako suttanto hoti ~o); Spk III 246, 17 (appaṭisaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ ~an ti pucchi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee appaṭisaraṇadhammassa paṭisaraṇaṃ).
